gates.label: Topic pre-check
gates.blurb: Before anything is written: is this subject too close to something the corpus already covers?

gates.label: Movement pre-check
gates.blurb: Does the paragraph-function skeleton repeat a shape the corpus has already used?

gates.label: Topology pre-check
gates.blurb: Does the question-type layout duplicate an existing set's topology?

gates.label: Style peek
gates.blurb: A short sample of the draft is compared for voice and rhythm before the full render continues.

gates.label: Passage audit
gates.blurb: The finished passage is scored against every neighbour on embedding, stylometry and cadence.

gates.label: Full audit
gates.blurb: Passage plus questions, scored across all nine channels and reduced to one composite.

gates.label: Final vet
gates.blurb: Compliance, answer-key sanity and corpus-level hygiene before the set is cleared.
